system.description:
You can edit and even reweave others' memories, detect the signs of someone else having altered your target's memories, and prompt your target to relive her memories and tell them to you.

To edit or erase someone's memories, win a Mental Challenge against her; this affects 15 minutes of memories. Erasing memories can be done in a turn; rewriting takes as long as it takes to relate the new memories to the player. Affecting a longer segment requires using Reveler's Memory again. You may attempt to detect, alter or reverse a prior use of this power by another Cainite by winning a Mental Challenge against the number of Mental Traits the original vampire possessed at the time. To force another to relive memories and relate them to you, win a Mental Challenge and prompt her with gentle questions; as long as you maintain eye contact and she is unthreatened, you can keep drawing out memories. You may not use this power on yourself.
